newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack board gets 1.4 bln stg-paper.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack board gets 1.4 bln stg-paper.

text.p: The board of directors of Railtrack Plc earned a total of 1.4 billion stg during the first year the group operated as a public company, a rise of 38 percent on 1996, the Independent said on Tuesday.

The newspaper, quoting figures from the company's annual report, noted that part of the increase could be attributed to the appointment of an extra director, Michael Howell, who left the group in March.
Excluding Howell's remuneration, Railtrack's directors awarded themselves 1.2 billion, including performance bonuses of 332,000 stg, representing a pay rise of almost 14 percent, the paper said.
The annual report also revealed that Howell received a payoff of more than 292,000. He resigned in March after one year with the company. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
